function.name: search_google
function.description: Performs a search query on Google and returns a list of URLs that match the search criteria. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query.description: The search term to query on Google.

num_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return. The number must be a positive integer.

language.description: The language for the search results.

filter.description: A flag to filter explicit content in search results.

date_range.description: The date range for the search results in the format 'MM/DD/YYYY-MM/DD/YYYY'. If not specified, searches across all dates.

message.content:
Here’s a quick snapshot of some of the most prominent vaccine manufacturers worldwide (as of 2026). These companies produce a wide range of vaccines—from routine childhood immunizations to specialty and pandemic vaccines.

| Company | Headquarters | Notable Vaccines | Key Highlights |
|---------|--------------|------------------|----------------|
| **Pfizer** | New York, USA | COVID‑19 (Comirnaty), HPV, Hepatitis B, Influenza | First mRNA COVID‑19 vaccine; strong global distribution network. |
| **Moderna** | Cambridge, USA | COVID‑19 (Spikevax), RSV (under development) | Pioneer in mRNA technology; rapid vaccine development platform. |
| **Johnson & Johnson (Janssen)** | New Jersey, USA | COVID‑19 (Ad26.COV2.S), HPV, Hepatitis A/B, Typhoid | Single‑dose adenovirus‑vector COVID vaccine; broad vaccine portfolio. |
| **Novavax** | Gaithersburg, USA | COVID‑19 (Nuvaxovid), Influenza, RSV (under development) | Protein‑subunit platform; high efficacy in early trials. |
| **AstraZeneca** | Cambridge, UK | COVID‑19 (AZD1222), HPV, Influenza, Typhoid | Adenovirus‑vector COVID vaccine; widely used in low‑ and middle‑income countries. |
| **Sanofi Pasteur** | Paris, France | Influenza, Hepatitis A/B, Typhoid, Rotavirus | One of the largest vaccine producers; strong presence in Europe and Africa. |
| **GlaxoSmithKline (GSK) Vaccines** | Brentford, UK | HPV (Cervarix), Influenza, Hepatitis B, Rotavirus | Focus on subunit and conjugate vaccines; strong R&D pipeline. |
| **Merck & Co. (MSD)** | Kenilworth, USA | HPV (Gardasil), Influenza, Meningococcal, Hepatitis B | Global immunization leader; extensive research in viral vector vaccines. |
| **Bharat Biotech** | Hyderabad, India | COVID‑19 (Covaxin), Hepatitis B, Influenza | Indigenous vaccine platform; significant contribution to India’s vaccine supply. |
| **Sinovac Biotech** | Beijing, China | COVID‑19 (CoronaVac), Influenza, Hepatitis B | Inactivated virus platform; large domestic and international reach. |
| **Sinopharm (China National Pharmaceutical Group)** | Beijing, China | COVID‑19 (BBIBP‑CorV), Influenza, Hepatitis B | Inactivated virus platform; major supplier to China and other countries. |
| **CureVac** | Tübingen, Germany | COVID‑19 (CVnCoV), RSV (under development) | mRNA platform with a focus on self‑amplifying RNA. |
| **BioNTech** | Mainz, Germany | COVID‑19 (BNT162b2) (in partnership with Pfizer) | mRNA platform; strong collaboration with Pfizer. |
| **Serum Institute of India** | Pune, India | Polio, Hepatitis B, Influenza, Rotavirus | Largest vaccine manufacturer by volume; key partner for WHO. |
| **Biontech (BioNTech)** | Mainz, Germany | COVID‑19 (BNT162b2) (in partnership with Pfizer) | mRNA platform; strong collaboration with Pfizer. |
| **GSK Vaccines** | Brentford, UK | HPV (Cervarix), Influenza, Hepatitis B, Rotavirus | Focus on subunit and conjugate vaccines; strong R&D pipeline. |
| **Sanofi Pasteur** | Paris, France | Influenza, Hepatitis A/B, Typhoid, Rotavirus | One of the largest vaccine producers; strong presence in Europe and Africa. |
| **Merck & Co. (MSD)** | Kenilworth, USA | HPV (Gardasil), Influenza, Meningococcal, Hepatitis B | Global immunization leader; extensive research in viral vector vaccines. |

### How to Use This List
- **Research**: If you’re looking into vaccine development, partnerships, or market trends, this table gives a quick reference to major players.
- **Supply Chain**: For procurement or distribution planning, note the geographic strengths and vaccine portfolios.
- **Academic**: For studies on vaccine technology, observe the diversity of platforms (mRNA, adenovirus vector, protein subunit, inactivated virus).

If you need more detailed information—such as specific product pipelines, recent clinical trial results, or financial data—just let me know!
